build_randomized_svd: build a truncated randomized SVD decomposition of a matrix extracting n_components singular values and vectors
create_safe_sparse_dot: create a sparse-aware dot product that correctly handles sparse and dense matrix combinations
compute_row_norms: compute row-wise Euclidean norms of a matrix supporting both dense and sparse inputs
apply_svd_flip: apply sign correction to SVD output matrices ensuring deterministic and reproducible results
calculate_softmax: calculate numerically stable softmax of a matrix by subtracting row maxima before exponentiation
